name: Process Monitor
tags: htop top process monitor cpu cores memory bars system linux
note: A top-style monitor with per-core meters drawn entirely from block characters, colour-graded by load, plus a process table that reorders itself as usage drifts.

name: Live Log Tail
note: A `tail -f` pane that streams new lines at irregular intervals with DBG/INF/WRN/ERR severity colouring, a pulsing LIVE indicator, auto-scroll, and running line/error counters.

name: Cron Schedule Table
note: A crontab listing where LAST ages up and NEXT counts down in real time; the soonest job is marked amber and every row flashes green as it fires and resets to its period.
